videos.desc: A smiling young woman stands in her room and proudly shows framed certificates to the camera, swapping one for another until she is hugging a whole armful of them.
videos.said: I study very hard. Look at all my certificates!

videos.desc: A young man in a navy cap and gown with a gold sash stands in a packed stadium at his graduation ceremony. He raises his diploma and cheers as golden confetti rains down.
videos.said: Today is my graduation. I am so happy!

videos.desc: A scientist in a white coat pulls on purple gloves in a laboratory, pipettes blue liquid into rows of tubes, writes notes on a pad, and stores a rack of samples in a lab freezer.
videos.said: I work in a laboratory. I do experiments every day.

videos.desc: A student in a dark red sweater stands in front of her class next to a projector screen with slides, speaking and gesturing at the bullet points while classmates watch.
videos.said: Hello. Today I give a presentation to my class. This is my work. I am a little nervous. Thank you for listening.

videos.desc: A young woman in a maroon cap and gown films herself at a huge stadium graduation ceremony, proudly holding up her degree certificate to the camera. She walks along the graduate rows, appears on the jumbotron, and celebrates as confetti rains down.
videos.said: I finished school. I finished. This is my degree!

videos.desc: A young man in a green cap and gown crosses the stage at a graduation ceremony, shakes hands with the officials, and is handed a white rolled diploma tied with a ribbon. He turns to the audience and triumphantly lifts the scroll over his head with both hands, beaming.
videos.said: Today I get my diploma! I am so proud!

videos.desc: In a Pixar-style kitchen, a woman in a striped apron drops a sugar cube into a glass of water and stirs it with a spoon. The cube breaks up and vanishes completely, and she holds up the clear glass with wide surprised eyes saying it is all gone.

On a rooftop at sunset a cartoon woman with goggles heats a pan of water on a camping stove. The shallow puddle of water shrinks, vanishes in a puff of steam and she flips the pan over to show it is completely empty and dry.
In a cozy study, a curly-haired woman excitedly shows off the desk globe next to her lamp, spins it fast, stops it with a finger to point out countries, then hugs the globe to the camera.
videos.said: Look at my globe! A globe is a small round earth. I spin the globe and I can see every country! Can you believe this?

videos.desc: A man with glasses sits at a desk late at night under a lamp, surrounded by open books and stacks of papers covered in sticky notes; he types on a laptop, checks the books and scribbles notes on the pages.

At a desk, a student tears a small piece from a green leaf, puts it on a glass slide and clips it under a microscope. He looks into the eyepiece and turns the focus knob until the leaf's tiny green cells appear sharp and huge in the round view.
videos.said: I look at a leaf in my microscope. The microscope makes it very big.

videos.desc: In a hand-painted anime scene, a girl crouches by a grassy stream and holds a magnifying glass up to a dragonfly perched on a cattail. She watches it closely and intently, then smiles at what she sees.

In a cartoon workshop a young scientist fires a ray gun at a man in a green tracksuit; he freezes mid-step with a glowing outline, stuck rigid in one pose while she waves at him and tests him, and he finally tips over stiff as a board into her arms.

A young couple sits at a laptop trying to code a small wheeled robot that stands on a paper track on the table. The robot won't obey, they groan with heads in hands, then type new code, and suddenly the robot drives along the drawn track - "It works!" - so they cheer, high-five and kiss.

A boy walks through a crowded school hallway carrying a giant expedition backpack with ice axes, a rolled sleeping mat and a tower of books stacked on top; amazed classmates watch as he proudly declares himself ready, then tips backward onto his sleeping roll to rest.
videos.said: Did you come here to sleep? I am a prepared student.

videos.desc: A tall silver rocket stands beside its steel launch tower on a concrete pad under a clear blue sky, venting white vapour. The engines light and orange flame and white smoke burst out around its base. The rocket lifts off the pad and rises past the tower, its exhaust turning to a bright pink and white column. It climbs out of frame and a huge cloud of pale smoke and dust rolls across the pad, leaving only the tower and the trail of fire above it.

In the bright hall of a science museum a woman in a denim jacket holds a small pink model of a brain in both hands close to the camera, frowning at it; behind her are display stands and other visitors. She turns the model over in her fingers and studies it. She then leans over a low white display counter set with several large anatomical brain models on stands and points at one of them. Finally she stands in front of a huge glowing pink brain sculpture mounted on a purple wall and looks up at it with her mouth open.

A woman in a mustard blouse and red glasses sits alone at a long desk in an empty lecture theatre, with a takeaway coffee cup beside her. She works through a pile of exam papers with a red pen, drawing corrections across a sheet, then putting it down and pulling the next one over. Each time she looks up the two piles either side of her have grown taller, until they tower well above her head and hide her behind them. At the end she sits back, staring up at the towers of paper with her mouth open, spare red pens scattered across the desk.

In a school laboratory a student in a white lab coat, safety goggles and blue gloves tips a blue liquid from a small beaker into a conical glass flask on a black bench. Within seconds a thick pale-blue foam surges up out of the flask's neck and pours down the sides onto the bench. The foam keeps growing into a tall column that rises higher than his head and turns pink, yellow and rainbow-coloured, while he steps back with his mouth open in astonishment and classmates watch in the background.

In a bright electronics lab a young man in glasses fits a black gripper onto the end of a jointed robotic arm bolted to the bench next to circuit boards and cables. He sits down at a sticker-covered laptop and types, watching the arm. The arm swings round on its own and holds out a white mug; he takes it, laughs and drinks from it, and two colleagues at the benches behind him raise their arms and cheer.

In a kitchen a woman in an apron drops a white tablet into a glass of water and small bubbles stream up through the water. She stirs it with a spoon, then lowers a big white block into a large glass tank where it fizzes into a swirling white cloud while she gasps at it.

A woman with glasses pushed up on her head sits at a desk walled in by towering stacks of books and bundles of paper. She reads an open book, writes on a small sticky note and looks up in surprise. The camera pulls back and the stacks keep growing until she is a tiny figure in the middle of a wall of books and files reaching the ceiling.

A schoolgirl in a grey jumper and white collar sits at a desk in a classroom writing in a spiral notebook with a pencil, other pupils working behind her and a whiteboard at the front. She puts her hand up, beams, and slaps a high five with a hand reaching in from off camera. A close-up shows her carrying on writing a list of lines down the page. An adult hand then presses a large gold glitter star sticker onto the finished page beside her writing. In the final shot she holds the open notebook up to the camera with both hands, the gold star on the page, laughing with delight.

A woman in a checked tweed blazer and black trousers walks past a wooden lectern into a large panelled lecture hall with a full audience, a leather case in her hand. In close-up her hand draws a wide chalk arc on a green blackboard. She then stands at the board beside a big chalk drawing of a circle with a cross of axes and labelled arrows pointing outwards, touching it with a wooden pointer as she speaks. Another close-up shows her chalking a formula with a fraction and arrows next to the drawing. At the end she faces the hall with both arms spread wide, smiling, the labelled circle drawing behind her.

A young woman in a white lab coat, white cap and safety goggles works in a busy laboratory. She pipettes bright blue liquid into a rack of test tubes, swirls a conical glass flask of blue-green liquid over a hotplate, then holds the flask up to the light and smiles at it. She bends to a microscope with a flask of blue liquid beside her, and at the end holds up a flask of glowing pink liquid while a colleague at the next bench watches.

A young woman in glasses and a beige cardigan sits at a long wooden table in a grand library, writing in an open textbook with a blue pen while other students work behind her. She piles more and more thick books on the table until the stacks form a wall taller than she is, and at the end she is hidden behind it, only her eyes showing as she looks out through a gap between the piles.

In an old classroom with a curved painted ceiling, gold trim, chandeliers and blue and white tiles along the walls, a young woman with long braids, in a green top and navy trousers, raises one finger as she speaks to a young man in a light blue shirt and cream trousers, holding papers in her other hand. He listens, then answers her with open hands and a surprised smile, while she holds her papers out towards him. Wooden desks stand between them, a green chalkboard hangs on the right and two students sit writing behind.
videos.said: And why? Great question. Let's start with the core principle.

videos.desc: In a sunny town square at a lemon festival, a young woman in a white lab coat, safety goggles and blue rubber gloves squeezes a lemon above her head over a long paper test strip. The strip turns from blue to bright red, and she shouts with joy as the crowd in summer clothes cheers, claps and films with phones. On a table beside her a bowl of white powder foams over next to a glass of juice. Behind the crowd rise a giant lion and a ship built from lemons and oranges under yellow bunting.

In a muddy scrapyard on a grey day, a huge round rusty electromagnet hangs from chains on a crane, with twisted bars and scraps of metal stuck to its underside. Two laughing workers in white hard hats and yellow high-visibility jackets, a young woman and a young man, hold on tight to flat metal sheets that the magnet pulls up towards itself, leaning back and struggling to keep them down. Piles of scrap metal lie against a concrete wall and a crane stands behind.

At a science show in a busy hall under a glass roof, a young man in a white lab coat and gloves holds up a clear dish under a purple lamp, showing a handprint made of glowing colonies of tiny germs in orange, pink, green and yellow. A large screen above him shows round and rod-shaped cells under a microscope. A young woman in a tracksuit top holds up her open hand beside him and stares at the dish in surprise, while teenagers behind a rope film with their phones.

In a grand hall with chandeliers, long tables covered in white cloth hold rows of chessboards and chess clocks. A young woman in a cream blouse and dark trousers, wearing a black blindfold, stands on the table holding up two fingers, then walks slowly along it between the boards, pointing down at them. Seated older men in jackets and jumpers stare at her in amazement, one man stands clutching his head with both hands, and a crowd of spectators watches from the back of the room.

Inside a plain old museum room with tall windows, a young woman in a grey coat, her dark hair in a bun, carefully lowers a heavy carved stone slab into its empty dusty outline on top of a glass display case, while an older man's hands help from the side. She lets go and smooths the dust around it, and the older man in a flat cap leans in to look closely. A crowd of people in winter jackets and caps watches. Other stone fragments stand inside the case, with work gloves on top and a bucket nearby.
